language_task: Put the spoon in the drawer.
outcome_evidence: The robot grasps and lifts the spoon at frames 91–121 (image, left_ego_image, wrist_image), then carries it toward the open drawer at frames 145–193. At frames 194–203, the spoon leaves the gripper and falls outside the drawer onto the tabletop. Frames 205–219 (image, left_ego_image) show it remaining on the table beside the cabinet, establishing a visibly failed placement rather than merely unconfirmed completion.

failure_annotations.explanation: At frames 194–198 (wrist_image, image), the previously held spoon moves downward out of the gripper outside the drawer; frames 199–203 (image, left_ego_image) show it falling and landing on the tabletop. This loss or release of the spoon fails to place it in the drawer; the images do not establish whether release was intentional or a slip.
failure_annotations.recovery: Reacquire the spoon from the tabletop, lift it clear of the cabinet, align it fully over the open drawer interior, and lower it before releasing; no human intervention is visibly necessary.
failure_annotations.severity_evidence: The spoon lands on the tabletop with no visible damage or disturbance of unrelated objects.
failure_annotations.resetability_evidence: The spoon remains accessible on the table and the drawer remains open, so another acquisition and placement attempt requires no environmental reset or human intervention.
